newsitem.title: UK: Granada takes 166 mln stg write-off.
newsitem.headline: Granada takes 166 mln stg write-off.

text.p: Granada Group Plc took a 166.7 million stg goodwill write-off relating to its Computer Services arm and other items in its first half results.
The write-off, which had been expected by analysts, is likely to herald the sale of the unit.
The company also took a 10.9 million stg exceptional charge relating to the closure of 100 of its high street rental stores.
However, these charges were more than balanced by gains on disposals, leaving an exceptional gain of 22.8 million stg in the period
Granada made a profit of 140 million stg on the sale of its Welcome Break motorway service stations, 52.6 million stg on hotel disposals and 7.8 million from the sale of its stake in Alpha Airports.
